title: Understanding Vue Performance
description: Learn what affects Vue app performance and how to measure it.

slides.title: What Makes a Vue App Fast?
slides.content:
# Key Performance Factors

- **Initial load time** – how long until the app becomes interactive.
- **Update performance** – how smoothly the UI reacts to state changes.
- **Memory usage** – avoiding leaks and unnecessary retained objects.

Vue is already fast out of the box, but as apps grow, you need to be mindful of:
- **Reactive dependencies** – too many watchers/computed.
- **Large lists** – rendering thousands of DOM nodes.
- **Component complexity** – deep nesting and many instances.
- **Network requests** – unoptimized fetching, no caching.

slides.title: Performance Metrics
slides.content:
# Measuring Performance

- **Lighthouse** – gives scores for performance, accessibility, best practices.
- **First Contentful Paint (FCP)** – when the first content appears.
- **Time to Interactive (TTI)** – when the page is fully interactive.
- **Total Blocking Time (TBT)** – sum of time blocking the main thread.
- **Largest Contentful Paint (LCP)** – when the main content is loaded.

Vue Devtools also provides a performance timeline to inspect component render times.

quizData.question: Which metric measures when the main content of a page is likely loaded?
quizData.explanation: Largest Contentful Paint (LCP) marks the point when the main content has loaded.
